# Status (`status`)

Status dot with label (connected, untested, error) and the LIVE badge.

Group: Feedback. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/feedback';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createStatus` (types in `dist/web/feedback/status.d.ts`): `.mh-status--online | --offline | --busy | --away | --error | --unknown | --live`: a dot and a label; `live` is the pulsing LIVE badge. Parts `__dot` (decorative) and `__label`.

```ts
export function createStatus(options: StatusOptions): StatusHandle;

export interface StatusOptions {
  state: StatusState;
  /** Visible label; defaults to the state ("Online", "Live"). */
  label?: string;
  /** Makes it a polite live region (`role="status"`) so changes are announced. */
  announce?: boolean;
}

export interface StatusHandle {
  el: HTMLSpanElement;
  setState(state: StatusState, label?: string): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createStatus } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// `announce` reads changes out to screen readers.
const status = createStatus({ state: navigator.onLine ? 'online' : 'offline', announce: true });

window.addEventListener('online', () => status.setState('online'));
window.addEventListener('offline', () => status.setState('offline'));

document.body.append(status.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Status } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function StatusExample() {
  const [online, setOnline] = useState(navigator.onLine);
  useEffect(() => {
    const update = () => setOnline(navigator.onLine);
    window.addEventListener('online', update);
    window.addEventListener('offline', update);
    return () => {
      window.removeEventListener('online', update);
      window.removeEventListener('offline', update);
    };
  }, []);
  // `announce` reads changes out to screen readers.
  return <Status state={online ? 'online' : 'offline'} announce />;
}
```
